5. Construct a trace table for the following algorithm:
N = 5
S = 0
R = 0
loop while N > 0
A = N mod 3
if A = 0
then
S = S – N
else
if A = 1
then
S = S + N
else
S = S + 1
end if
end if
R = R + S
N = N - 1
end loop
